title: How to Add Your Own Story
title_en: How to Add Your Own Story
sentences: A story file is a small text file that holds your own tale.
Open Notepad and start a new empty document.
Write an id, a language, a title and a list of sentences.
Give every story its own id so it never clashes with others.
Keep each sentence short so it fits on one line.
Save it as UTF eight text and end the name with dot json.
Put the file in the stories folder in your local app data.
Close the typing practice window and open it again.
Your own story now appears in the story list.
Personal stories are for you, so type them and enjoy them.
Sharing text you did not write needs its owner's permission.
